description: Two-role development primitive. Reason with one model class, build with another. Portable across harnesses and providers. This file is the single source of truth: edit the model classes below and re-run apply.py to regenerate every harness adapter.

planner.purpose: planning and reasoning about the project: architecture, design, root-cause analysis, trade-off calls, sequencing work, and reviewing an approach before it is built

builder.purpose: actual scripting and building: writing and editing code, creating files, running builds and tests, and applying a plan end to end

routing.note: Substantive reasoning goes to the planner; substantive implementation goes to the builder. Trivial lookups and one-line edits skip the round-trip.
